title: About the Editor
paragraphs: Logan Chipkin is President and Cofounder of Conjecture Institute, a nonprofit organization dedicated to spreading and applying humanity’s deepest ideas. He coauthored _Lords of the Cosmos_ (with Arjun Khemani), was junior author of _The Sovereign Child_ (primary author: Aaron Stupple), and edited our previous compendium, _Bold Conjectures, Volume I: Select Interviews of David Deutsch_.
